method: All ten overviews plus first 24 final-detection native crops; brightness x2 for inspection only. Source-like counts are visual lower bounds in the inspected prefix, not catalog identities or whole-frame recall. WCS separately reviewed all 63 high-weight crops.

frames.observation: Dense stellar field; strong common elongated profiles, saturated cores, structured Milky Way and horizon. Crop 10 is terrain; 20 diffuse. Many detections are stellar but no accepted match. Shape/rank/catalog compatibility remains open.
frames.root_cause_status: not established from visual review alone
